verdict.rationale: Ardent's own REST API uses a version prefix in its endpoint paths (/v1/connectors/...), so the API is versioned at least implicitly. The evidence has no documented versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The CLI's 'stable JSON' output and stable error codes are a different surface and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented API versioning policy, documented deprecation policy and timelines, sunset/changelog notices, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
